description: Implementation of a QUIC bidirectional stream handling class, including stream management, headers processing, data reading/writing, and error handling within the Chromium network stack.

classes.name: ScopedBoolSaver
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily set a boolean value and restore it when out of scope.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::Start
methods.description: Initiates a new QUIC bidirectional stream with request info, delegate, and traffic annotation.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::SendRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sends HTTP/2 headers over the stream.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::WriteHeaders
methods.description: Constructs and writes headers to the stream.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::SendvData
methods.description: Sends multiple buffers as stream data, optionally ending the stream.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::GetProtocol
methods.description: Returns the negotiated protocol.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received on the stream.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent on the stream.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Provides load timing information.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Populates network error details.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::OnStreamReady
methods.description: Callback when stream is ready.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::OnSendDataComplete
methods.description: Callback after data is sent.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::OnReadInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback after initial headers are read.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::ReadInitialHeaders
methods.description: Initiates reading of initial headers.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::ReadTrailingHeaders
methods.description: Initiates reading of trailing headers.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::OnReadTrailingHeadersComplete
methods.description: Callback after trailing headers are read.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::OnReadDataComplete
methods.description: Callback after data read completes.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::NotifyError
methods.description: Handles error notification.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::NotifyErrorImpl
methods.description: Internal error notification handler.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::NotifyFailure
methods.description: Notifies delegate of failure.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::NotifyStreamReady
methods.description: Notifies delegate that stream is ready.

methods.name: BidirectionalStreamQuicImpl::ResetStream
methods.description: Resets stream state and records stats.
